How Iowa Bin Stores Work: The Weekly Pricing Model Bin stores in Iowa offer incredible savings on brand-name merchandise. These stores purchase overstock inventory, Amazon returns, and liquidated items from major retailers like Target, Walmart, and Home Depot, then pass massive discounts to shoppers. Most stores follow a weekly pricing model, restock on specific days (usually Saturday), and maintain active Facebook pages with updates.
